materials.vertexShader: varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; void main(){vN=normalize(normalMatrix*normal); vec4 mv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.); vV=-mv.xyz; gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv;}
materials.fragmentShader: uniform vec3 u_color; uniform float u_alpha; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vV; void main(){float f=1.-abs(dot(normalize(vN),normalize(vV))); gl_FragColor=vec4(u_color,u_alpha*(0.25+2.2*f*f*f));}
